status: descriptive; computed from repository transcription files; not inferential
method: Compare next-character vowel rate after ch/sh only within matched folio × exact token length × digraph-position cells, then stratify by IVTFF $Q and $I.
interpretation: Descriptive contrast persists in the largest Q=T stratum across both transcriptions; it varies across other Q labels. No p-value, causal claim, or decoding claim.
limitations: Repeated word types are not independently controlled
IVTFF $I labels are not assumed to be scribal hands
